tools.name: search_stars
tools.description: Search and filter the user's GitHub starred repositories in Starlens.

query.description: Search query. Optional when filters are provided.

tools.name: show_star
tools.description: Get one starred repository detail by Starlens id or owner/repo.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tools.name: sync_stars
tools.description: Trigger GitHub Stars sync for the authenticated Starlens user.

tools.name: favorite_star
tools.description: Mark a starred repository as favorite. This only sets a local Starlens flag — it does NOT change your real star status on GitHub. Use star_repo/unstar_repo for that.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tools.name: unfavorite_star
tools.description: Remove favorite state from a starred repository. This only clears a local Starlens flag — it does NOT unstar the repo on GitHub. Use unstar_repo to actually remove a GitHub star.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tools.name: star_repo
tools.description: Actually star a repository on GitHub (calls the real GitHub star API, not just a local Starlens flag). Accepts any 'owner/repo' — including repos you've never starred before — or an existing Starlens id/fullName (e.g. to re-star a repo you previously unstarred). After starring, the repo is synced into your Starlens collection.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tools.name: unstar_repo
tools.description: Actually remove your GitHub star from a repository (calls the real GitHub unstar API — the repo will disappear from your GitHub Stars page). This is different from unfavorite_star, which only clears a local Starlens flag and leaves the GitHub star intact. Only works on repos already in your Starlens collection.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tools.name: set_star_note
tools.description: Set or clear the user's note for a starred repository.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

note.description: Note text. Use an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: add_star_tag
tools.description: Add a user tag to a starred repository.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tag.description: User tag to add or remove.

tools.name: remove_star_tag
tools.description: Remove a user tag from a starred repository.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

tag.description: User tag to add or remove.

tools.name: ask_stars
tools.description: Ask Starlens AI to answer a question over the user's starred repositories.

tools.name: analyze_repo
tools.description: Call this tool when the user drops a repository (owner/repo) for analysis and you want to surface what the repo is good for and suggest tags/notes. Triggers when the user says 'analyze this repo', 'what is X good for', or pastes a GitHub URL and asks for a summary. Works for both starred and unstarred repos; for unstarred repos it fetches live GitHub data without persisting it.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

applySuggestions.description: Whether to automatically apply suggested tags/note to the user's starred repo. Defaults to false. Set to true only after the user has confirmed the suggestions. Has no effect on unstarred repos.

tools.name: recommend_for_task
tools.description: Call this tool when the user starts a coding task (new feature, tech selection, research, library comparison) and you want to find relevant libraries or prior art from their GitHub starred repos BEFORE writing code. Triggers when the user says 'I'm going to build X', 'help me pick a library for Y', or describes a task that would benefit from prior starred knowledge.

taskDescription.description: Natural-language description of the coding task the user is starting.

limit.description: Max number of recommended repos. Default 10.

tools.name: find_related
tools.description: Call this tool when the user mentions a specific repository (owner/repo) and wants to discover related repos they have already starred. Triggers when the user says 'find repos like X', 'what else do I have similar to Y', or when after showing a repo detail the user wants to explore its neighborhood. Returns repos sharing the same owner, language, or topics, ranked by AI semantic similarity.

repo.description: Starlens repository id or owner/repo full name.

limit.description: Max number of related repos. Default 10.

tools.name: suggest_organization
tools.description: Call this tool when the user mentions organizing, cleaning up, deduplicating, or auditing their starred repo collection. Triggers when the user says 'help me organize my stars', 'find duplicates', 'what's stale', 'which repos have no tags', or 'audit my collection'. Returns suggestions only — does not modify data; the agent must call add_star_tag/remove_star_tag/etc. to apply changes after user confirmation.

focus.description: Which kind of organization suggestions to return. Default 'all'.

tools.name: get_sync_summary
tools.description: Call this tool at the start of a new session, or when the user asks 'what's new', 'what changed since last sync', or 'show me recent additions to my stars'. Returns a summary of repos added/removed/changed since the last sync (or since an arbitrary timestamp). Use this proactively to give the user context about their recent starred-repo activity without requiring them to ask explicitly.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to the user's last sync finished time.
